Archiving is a conscious gesture here as everywhere: no
task archives itself. This act reaches the one board the
user is on, unlike a change to the template itself.
A task cannot be left without a column, so the cascade is
approve-or-abandon and detaching is not offered.

A name is not a role (BR-58), so nothing here can touch
the one Backlog or the last Done (BR-59). InProgress is
the role most added lanes carry (`arch section 10`);
saying a new lane means something else is the role act's
own business. A new lane appears on every board the
template governs (BR-108), and the check-out and the
advisor read a lane's role, never its name.
